about: Ease is garment minus body, flat, for rigid denim after its first wash. Background: docs/research/ease.md. Change it only by PR.

stretch.about: Stretch products: every range 2 cm lower measured around the body (1 cm flat), never below the minimum, and a minimum ease of 0. Decided with the user on 20 November 2026.

sources.rudolf-2021: Rudolf, Stjepanovič & Cupar, Materials 14(18):5124 (2021): minimum ease for woven trousers of 3.5 cm at the hip, 1 cm at the thigh, 1.5 cm at the knee, 1 cm at the waist (around). https://doi.org/10.3390/ma14185124
sources.dove-menswear: Tanya Dove, Menswear Pattern Cutting: 4 cm of seat ease so you can sit down; +2 cm at the trouser waist (seen in an excerpt).
sources.fashion-capital-block: Fashion Capital trouser block, about +4 cm total at the seat. https://www.fashioncapital.co.uk/tools/how-to-construct-a-basic-trouser-block/
sources.freesewing-titan: FreeSewing Titan defaults: seat 2%, waist 2%, knee 6%. https://freesewing.eu/docs/designs/titan/options/
sources.nmsu-c227: NMSU Guide C-227: waist 1/2-1 in, hip 2 in, thigh 1 in (around). https://pubs.nmsu.edu/_c/C227/
sources.nmsu-c209: NMSU Guide C-209: waist up to 1 in, hips at least 2-4 in, thigh 1-2 in, knee at least 1 in (around). https://pubs.nmsu.edu/_c/C209/
sources.kim-nam-2016: Kim & Nam, Fashion & Textile Research Journal 18(1) (2016): comfortable knee ease 6 cm standing, 10 cm sitting (around).
sources.style-arc-blakley: Style Arc Blakley stretch jean (about 3% elastane): about -4 cm at the hip, around.
